display_long_description:
A new way to experience a home before it exists. Projected Living allows you to explore homes and real estate developments before they are built at a real 1:1 scale, using advanced 3D visualization, Augmented Reality (AR), and Virtual Reality (VR) technology.

Our platform transforms the way off-plan real estate projects are presented and marketed. By combining immersive experiences with powerful sales tools, Projected Living helps buyers truly understand the spaces, increasing confidence, interest, and speed in the decision-making process.

The experience can be enjoyed from different devices, always offering a fluid, intuitive and high-quality display for both business teams and end customers.

Main features:
• 1:1 scale visualization – experience the spaces as they will be built
• Free movement – ​​explore the property without fixed points, as if you were in a video game
• Augmented Reality tours – explore the spaces by walking through AR
• Centralized marketing content repository – renders, floor plans, 360° views, infographics, and project information
• Real-world context – image integration to visualize real views of the development
• Comparison of layouts and finishes – instantly switch between floor plans and materials
• Interactive exteriors – visualize the development within its urban environment
• Advanced sales tools – guided tours, inventory control, metrics, and analytics
• Remote sales – conduct immersive guided tours with clients from anywhere in the world
